eps.d: Timothy Lumsden meets a girl at his amateur dramatics society and determines to go on a riverboat shuffle with her, despite all his mother's attempts to prevent him.
The latest girl in Timothy's life has a jealous boyfriend who doesn't take kindly to him trying to steal her away.
Timothy tries to stop his godson being bullied at school.
Timothy makes a determined effort to find himself a flat.

eps.t: Does Your Mother Know You're Out?
eps.d: Timothy wants to go to the cinema, but his mother wants him to spend his evenings painting.
Timothy's sister Muriel comes to stay and tries to persuade him to go home with her.
Timothy tries to arrange his parents' second honeymoon, so that he can have a party at home in their absence.
Timothy is suffering from bouts of sleepwalking, which could cause trouble as the annual interview for promotion is just around the corner.
Timothy's handsome cousin Brinsley comes to stay - and supplants Timothy in Mother's affections.
Mother is out to get Aunt Esme's money for Timothy, and Timothy has encounters with a garage owner and his dogs.

Timothy, after some initial complications, is asked to be best man at his friend Frank's wedding. He ends up in trouble as a result of trying to encourage the idea of marriage in spite of his parents.

With Frank 's wedding impending, Timothy sets his cap at bridesmaid Liz. Will our hero get his head out of the railings in time? Will he forget the ring? And if he gets married, will Mother come on the honeymoon?
Following Timothy Lumsden, a bachelor librarian who lives with his parents. Tim goes in search of the Golden Rabbit and finds a girl.
Timothy is a bachelor in his forties who lives with his parents. Tim goes away for the weekend - and plans a holiday.
Tim tries to help Freddie's son - who thinks Tim is a wally. Tim plays Bottom in the local drama society's production of a Midsummer Night's Dream.
The library van breaks down and Tim gets some interesting news from three old ladies. With great cunning he sets off for a job interview - only to find that his mother comes too.

eps.t: It Never Rained in Those Days
eps.d: It's Timothy's mother birthday and he arranges a special treat - a meeting with an old friend.
Tim collapses and ends up in Casualty where he manages to muddle up his charts and convinces himself he's going to die. He records his last confession.
In this tale St George rescues the damsel and settles for co-existence with the dragon.
Timothy dips his toe in the antique trade and Father traps his finger in the pianola.

eps.t: One of Our Naughty Bits is Missing
eps.d: Timothy tries to find an adult book - but finds himself in a brown paper wrapper instead.
Timothy is a bachelor who lives with his parents. Suspicion and jealousy stalk suburbia.
The breaks go Timothy Lumsden's way until he's snookered behind the washing machine.
Timothy Lumsden meets the bearded lady and things get hairy.

eps.t: The Primal Scene, So to Speak
eps.d: Tim gets tied up in a bedroom farce when he tries his hand as a writer.

eps.t: Every Clown Wants to Play Hamlet
eps.d: Tim is prompting on the local production of Hamlet but his mind is elsewhere. Father has disappeared and Mother threatens to start a new life with Uncle Claud. How will it all end?
Tim pursues his piano teacher, Miss Clanger, while trying to solve the riddle left in a note from his dead Uncle Barstable.
Dead and buried at 43! Shy, retiring Tim won't make a clean break and sets out to prove he's still as lively as a kitten.
Fenella lives on a narrow boat and runs a children's theatre. Tim is like a puppet in her hands, but who's pulling the strings?
Timothy Lumsden finds out that life just isn't the same without him.
An escaped convict, a female mud wrestler, vicars, tarts and a French maid, not forgetting the bootleg whisky, find their way into Timonthy's home. And then an Inspector calls!
Tim meets up with Jennifer, a girl from his past. Muriel is eager to play cupid and arranges a meeting for them. Mother attempts to scupper their plans.
Timothy attends an assertiveness training programme, and asserts himself with his mother; the results are rather surprising.
Mother makes Tim promise not to marry once she's dead. He does not believe she will die before he marries, so agrees. But shortly afterwards she appears to have committed suicide.
As his wedding day approaches, Tim discovers that marriages are not necessarily happy ever after.

eps.t: Do You Take This Man - and His Mother?
eps.d: Tim is about to break free from Mother's apron strings in order to tie the knot with Jennifer. Everything is organised. Father is back from Australia and Frank is Best Man. But will Mother let Tim go that easily?
Muriel persuades Timothy that his only hope of escaping from Mother is to buy his own cottage.
Timothy is given a lucky charm with amazing powers. He soon discovers that his mother, not fate, is shaping his destiny.
Timothy demonstrates how gullible he is when he meets up with an old friend.
Timothy finds his dream girl but his mother blackmails him into standing her up.
Timothy shows Mother, Father and Pippa round his new home. Mother gets a chance to put Pippa off Timothy for life.
It is Timothy's last day at home and, after overcoming his mother's attempts to stop him, he flies away!
